search_rounds.result: Solved a one-fixed-tacnode quartic parameterization. For A=v^2-4c nonzero its generic four-fiber configuration is III*+I1+I1+I1. T0 and T1 are explicit plane presentations.
For baseline models 4, 8 and 10, no integer palindromic G of degree 5 or 6 makes F=((1+w)^2/w)G reproduce the first four reduced moments.
For baseline models 4, 8 and 10, none of 495 centrally symmetric four-pair supports in the stated rank-2 box reaches the third reduced moment.
T0 has exactly the baseline model-1 period, so the stored model-1 Laurent polynomial and certificate cover T0.

curve_models: Classify the delta-two unibranch boundary (ramphoid-cusp type) and degenerate tacnode cases at infinity.
Check whether the two-node invariant parameterization misses rational presentations even when it covers the geometric class.
After the quartic boundary is exhausted, prescribe delta-three singularity clusters for quintics so the generic normalization remains genus one.
laurent_polynomials: Search T1 as a period of a meromorphic differential: allow three variables and order-three recurrences rather than forcing a reflexive-polygon order-two template.
For models 4, 8 and 10, move to five or six monomial pairs, nonsymmetric supports, and mutation templates; use the known ODE recurrence as an early exact filter.
Normalize models 6 and 11 before support search so their large arithmetic scales do not dominate coefficient solving.
oeis: Repeat exact-prefix checks whenever a normalization changes.
Search transformed sequences separately: signs, shifts, binomially reduced sequences, and primitive rescalings.
Record a direct OEIS identifier only after exact term-by-term confirmation.
